purpose: Browse and create permission-scoped projects and open their versioned authored assets independently of live provider resources.
navigation_model: Projects are level-one tree rows and their authorized authored assets are level-two rows.

states.default: Authorized projects and loaded assets appear as a keyboard-operable tree.
states.loading: Project and asset loading are exposed without discarding the tree.
states.empty: A create-project action accompanies the explanation.
states.error: List or project errors provide an explicit retry.
states.permission: Only projects/assets returned by the authoritative service are shown; access labels remain visible.
states.disconnected_or_stale: Version conflict and unavailable service errors preserve the last visible identity and provide reload.

keyboard: Tree rows use arrows, Enter and Space; create dialog has labelled fields and deterministic default action.
pointer: Single-click selects, expander toggles children, double-click opens; commands provide non-pointer equivalents.
persistence: Projects and immutable asset revisions use authenticated backend authority with optimistic revision/version checks.
multi_window: Opened assets inherit their registered surface detach policy; Project Explorer remains a navigator.
accessibility: Tree hierarchy, busy/error state, filter result scope and dialog validation are programmatically labelled.
